# SurveyMonkey

SurveyMonkey is an online survey development platform that enables users to create, distribute, and analyze surveys for various purposes.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/survey-monkey/.

## Actions

- **Create Survey**: Create a new survey.
- **Delete Survey**: Delete a specific survey.
- **Get Contacts** (read-only): Retrieve a list of contacts.
- **Get Groups** (read-only): Retrieve a list of groups.
- **Get Survey Collectors** (read-only): Retrieve a list of collectors for a specific survey.
- **Get Survey Details** (read-only): Retrieve metadata and counts for a specific survey.
- **Get Survey Responses** (read-only): Retrieve a list of responses for a specific survey.
- **Get Surveys** (read-only): Retrieve a list of surveys.
